news.title: Regarding Mateo #Pellegrino, we had spoken about a meeting in Milan between #Parma and #Fiorentina...
news.text: Regarding Mateo #Pellegrino, we had spoken about a meeting in Milan between #Parma and #Fiorentina post mid-June. #Parma had inquired about #Piccoli who is now the center of other interests. #Pellegrino has waited and continues to wait for #Juventus which is now also focused on #Zirkzee.[Alfredo Pedullà]

news.title: 🚨 The #Fiorentina track for Mateo #Pellegrino has held strong since mid June, when we exclusively...
news.text: 🚨 The #Fiorentina track for Mateo #Pellegrino has held strong since mid June, when we exclusively revealed it, and still valid. The viola are searching for a new club for #Piccoli and are targeting the Argentine from #Parma who has been waiting for #Juventus for weeks and could break his hesitation in favor of the viola if there is an acceleration to finalize his exit from the ducali.[Gianluigi Longari]

news.title: Affondo dei direttori sul mercato. ALL-IN Juve, ma alle sue condizioni.
news.text: Il mercato bianconero entra nella fase più calda: Suzuki, Zirkzee e Lucumí sono gli obiettivi. Intanto il popolo juventino saluta uno dei suoi tifosi più illustri.

news.title: L'Atalanta ha pronta un'offerta da 20 milioni per Kristensen
news.text: L'Atalanta continua a spingere per Thomas Kristensen, difensore classe 2002 dell'Udinese, individuato come uno dei principali obiettivi per rinforzare il reparto arretrato in questa sessione di mercato.

news.title: Non solo Licina: l'Avellino ha chiesto alla Juventus anche un altro giovane
news.text: L'Avellino continua a lavorare per regalare ad Alessandro Nesta un rinforzo di qualità sulla trequarti.

news.title: Di Marzio: "Pellegrino prima scelta della Fiorentina in caso di cessione di Piccoli"
news.text: La Fiorentina prepara le prossime mosse per il reparto offensivo e segue con attenzione l'evoluzione del possibile trasferimento di Roberto Piccoli al Bologna.

news.title: Pellegrino in uscita, il Parma sta chiudendo per David Romero del Tigre
news.text: Mentre si rincorrono le voci di mercato su Pellegrino, corteggiato dalla Juventus e da altri importanti club, il Parma si cautela.

news.title: #Lucumí: new dialogues on the way between #Juventus and #Bologna. The emiliano club is now asking...
news.text: #Lucumí: new dialogues on the way between #Juventus and #Bologna. The emiliano club is now asking for 20 millions plus bonuses, while #Juve is starting from a lower figure. For now, #Lucumí continues to wait despite other offers.[Alfredo Pedullà]

news.title: 🇳🇱⚠️ "There are some initial whispers on #Koopmeiners, it's true. I verified and...
news.text: 🇳🇱⚠️ "There are some initial whispers on #Koopmeiners, it's true. I verified and found some confirmations about an exploratory attempt by English clubs, such as #Newcastle, but not only. We will see if these whispers will lead to a much more concrete situation, as #Juventus would prefer, since they do not consider him untouchable: someone will have to leave after all." [Alfredo Pedullà - Youtube via @juventusinsidernews]

news.title: Juventus, cosa va e cosa non va dopo la gara col Chelsea
news.text: La vittoria per 1-0 sul Chelsea nell'amichevole di Hong Kong offre spunti incoraggianti, ma lascia ancora alcune questioni aperte in casa Juventus.

news.title: 😱 SUITORS FOR #KOOPMEINERS #Napoli has asked for information, in recent hours, for Teun...
news.text: 😱 SUITORS FOR #KOOPMEINERS#Napoli has asked for information, in recent hours, for Teun #Koopmeiners. The Dutch midfielder is on the balance sheet for roughly 33 million - approximately - as of last July, and could leave if permanent offers arrive. In recent days, he has also been followed by #ManchesterUnited and #AstonVilla.[TuttoJuve via @AverageJuventinoGuy]

news.title: Il Besiktas spera di convincere Vlahovic per rispondere al colpo Salah del Trabzonspor
news.text: Il futuro di Dusan Vlahovic continua a tenere banco sul mercato internazionale.

news.title: #Atlético is looking for a way to let Alexander #Sørloth leave and is asking around 40 million...
news.text: #Atlético is looking for a way to let Alexander #Sørloth leave and is asking around 40 million euros for the transfer.The Norwegian striker is open to moving to the Turkish league, but only in exchange for a very lucrative contract.If #Sørloth were to leave, #Atlético would go after Dušan #Vlahović. #Beşiktaş is also after #Vlahović.[Matteo Moretto]

news.title: Lucumì tra Juve e Chelsea
news.text: Il Bologna continua a concentrarsi sul fronte delle cessioni, passaggio ritenuto fondamentale per sbloccare le prossime operazioni di mercato. Tra i nomi più caldi c'è quello di John Lucumí, che resta in attesa di sviluppi.

news.title: Cudrig, sfida Empoli-Arezzo per il talento della Juventus Next Gen
news.text: L'Empoli continua a seguire con attenzione Nicolò Cudrig, centrocampista classe 2002 della Juventus Next Gen, considerato uno dei profili più interessanti per rinforzare la rosa in vista della nuova stagione.

news.title: Il Como annuncia l'arrivo di Yan Couto
news.text: Il Como continua a essere tra i club più attivi di questa sessione estiva di mercato e mette a segno un altro innesto di rilievo.

news.title: Borsa, giornata negativa per la Juventus e Stellantis. Positiva Ferrari
news.text: Chiusura prevalentemente positiva per le principali Borse europee, con Piazza Affari tra le protagoniste della giornata. L'indice Ftse Mib ha terminato gli scambi in progresso dello 0,44%, attestandosi a 53.

news.title: Gatti, l'opzione Napoli si allontana: i partenopei virano su un altro obiettivo
news.text: Si parla ormai da settimane di un Federico Gatti in procinto di uscire dalla Juve.

news.text: "Il mercato della Juventus non lo sto capendo, confesso questo. Però lo potremo giudicare il 1° settembre".

news.text: L'Italia Under 20 Femminile scalda i motori in vista del Mondiale in Polonia che partirà il prossimo cinque settembre.

news.text: Fabio Paratici ha fatto il colpo grosso. L'ex Juve infatti ha portato alla fine alla Fiorentina Franco Mastantuono, il colpo da novanta della campagna acquisti della Viola.

news.title: 🇧🇷🧐 #Everton is interested in #DouglasLuiz, but he replied "No, thank you": he is...
news.text: 🇧🇷🧐 #Everton is interested in #DouglasLuiz, but he replied "No, thank you": he is becoming increasingly convinced that staying could be the right choice. #Spalletti is involving him a lot, even though no decision on his future has been made. He has admirers in the Premier League, but for now, the idea is to seek redemption as a bianconero and prove his worth. The coach is studying how to deploy him: he believes his qualities can make a difference in his style of football.[Giovanni Albanese - Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

news.text: 🇳🇱🆙 "For the attack, #Spalletti is becoming increasingly convinced on #Zirkzee, #Massara's favorite. #ManchesterUnited has opened to a loan with an option to buy, without an obligation. #Juventus is accelerating because it is an economically sustainable formula. news.text: 🧤⁉️ "For the goal, many names have been proposed: #Trubin, #Ederson, #Pickford and #MilinkovicSavic. Evaluations are underway, but #Juventus's, however, remains #Suzuki. There is also #Vicario: the bianconero club already has his 'yes', he earns around €4M and #Tottenham would even let him leave on a free loan with an option to buy, but #Spalletti is not particularly convinced by this name."[Nicolò Schira - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

news.title: 🇨🇴🧐 "#Juventus is looking for a defender and I continue to point to #Lucumí, who is...
news.text: 🇨🇴🧐 "#Juventus is looking for a defender and I continue to point to #Lucumí, who is #Spalletti's first choice. There is competition from the Premier League and now the price tag is at €25M. The bianconeri are offering €17M, #NottinghamForest €20M, but he prefers the Piedmont club, with whom an agreement in principle is already in place for a five-year contract worth €2.5M + bonuses. #Bologna, however, wants €25M and is not interested in other players in exchange."[Nicolò Schira - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

news.title: 👀🔛 "In these hours, #Massara and #Ottolini are working in Milan, together with #Carnevali...
news.text: 👀🔛 "In these hours, #Massara and #Ottolini are working in Milan, together with #Carnevali and with #Chiellini as a point of reference. The fact that the management has remained operational is symptomatic with a #Juventus that is active on the mercato. From a distance, the coach confers daily with the directors. There is total harmony and he trusts them: the arrivals have given him confidence. Eyes wide open: in the silence, la Vecchia Signora is absolutely making some moves."[Romeo Agresti - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

news.title: 🧤🧐 #Juventus has decided to postpone its project to secure a goalkeeper until the summer of...
news.text: 🧤🧐 #Juventus has decided to postpone its project to secure a goalkeeper until the summer of 2027. Limited economic resources, the lack of a domino effect and the high costs of top players have put the plans on hold. #PSG is about to finalize the signing of #Suzuki for around €35M, but the bianconeri are hoping for a simple loan, delaying everything until next year. The #Vicario and #Atubolu tracks remain alive, but the main target continues to be the Japanese.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]
